metadata.source: Official Notifications of SBI, IBPS & IBPS RRB

exams.name: SBI Clerk (Junior Associate) Mains
exams.sectional_cutoff: No sectional cutoffs prescribed by SBI; only overall aggregate cutoff applies.

time_management.strategy: Direct Factual Sweep: Read questions and instantly mark 100% known questions (Target: 25-30 Qs answered).
Analytical / Elimination Sweep: Attack 50-50 eliminated questions and current affairs where memory recall is required.
Review Marked for Review & Negative Risk Assessment: Strictly avoid wild guesses on unknown facts.

exams.name: IBPS Clerk (Customer Service Associate) Mains
exams.sectional_cutoff: YES. IBPS applies mandatory sectional cutoffs (typically 12 - 18 marks depending on category and state).

time_management.strategy: Clear the sectional cutoff immediately by nailing guaranteed Tier-1 banking facts and schemes.
Maximise score on recent RBI circulars, payment systems, and financial current affairs.
Recheck doubtful questions and secure high percentile.

exams.name: IBPS RRB Office Assistant (Multipurpose) Mains
exams.target_section: General Awareness (with strong Rural Banking emphasis)
exams.sectional_cutoff: YES. Mandatory sectional cutoff applies in RRB Mains.

time_management.strategy: Because RRB OA has a composite 2-hour duration for all 5 sections, finish Financial Awareness in 15-18 minutes to save critical time for Quantitative Aptitude and Reasoning puzzles.

special_focus_areas: NABARD role, structure, and refinance schemes (RIDF, LTIF)
RRB capital shareholding (50% Centre : 35% Sponsor Bank : 15% State Govt)
Agricultural Priority Sector targets (18% overall, 10% small/marginal farmers)
Kisan Credit Card (KCC), PM-KISAN, PMFBY, and SHG bank linkage
